observations.description: Wide shot of the football pitch showing players in white and red jerseys positioned across the field. The scoreboard displays 'UAE 0 - 1 OMA' with the match clock at 75:11. Players are jogging and repositioning as play continues.

The camera maintains a wide view of the midfield. A player in a white jersey receives a pass near the center circle and advances forward. Red-jerseyed defenders adjust their positions to intercept. The scoreboard remains 'UAE 0 - 1 OMA' with the clock progressing from 75:12 to 75:46.

Continuing the wide shot, the player in white passes the ball towards the left flank. Another white-jerseyed player runs onto the pass near the penalty area boundary. Defenders in red converge on the ball carrier. The scoreboard still shows 'UAE 0 - 1 OMA' at 75:47.
